title: Psychedelic Multi-Armed Alien
description: A vibrant surreal painting features a green multi-armed alien creature with large expressive eyes at the center. The figure has six arms, holds various symbols including playing cards and a skull, and is surrounded by floating orbs containing faces, a lotus flower, dripping paint effects, and abstract elements against a dynamic background of bold diagonal magenta, pink, and lime green brushstrokes.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic painting of a green multi-armed alien creature with big cartoon eyes and antennae, positioned centrally with six hands holding playing cards, a skull, and other symbols. The creature is surrounded by floating transparent orbs containing faces, a pink lotus flower, and abstract patterns. Bold diagonal streaks of hot pink, magenta and lime green slash across a dark purple background with dripping paint effects and small floating icons.
